steps.content: DisCity Central Library
How long... has it been going on?
The flames burn out. The last standing clock has collapsed. She can no longer tell the time.
Celine struggles through the burning bookshelves. Corruptors, Puppets, and contamination sorcery come at her in endless waves, and she resists them all.
All around her, the fallen Underground Puppets lie scattered everywhere.
She opens the book in her hands and glances at the table of contents. Ah, she's lost another batch of memories.
Now I've even forgotten everything from my favorite book from my childhood.
Memory Maniafication... What an inconvenient ability...
Why must the guardian of the truth gain her power from forgetting?
The Puppets' attacks are almost too reckless, too brutal. Of course, they're here to kill her. But...

Several streams of light spill from the book's pages. The instant they touch the Puppets, those filthy bodies shatter and dissipate like melting wax. Looks like she still has enough power left to tackle them.
This time, she'll use the name <color=#fb9259>Celine Fabius</color>, along with everything tied to it.
She's already exhausted all the expendable memories... All that's left are the precious ones. She must choose carefully. One wrong choice, and that memory will be gone forever.
She can't bear to lose them.
<i>She can't bear to lose them.
The blazing flames warp the air. Through the distortion, she can see the fissures tearing through her precious books.
Someone has told her that this is the enemy's dimension technology, and that it was stolen from the Ring Research Institute.
Even now, they need to kill with someone else's knife. How very discreet these assassins are.
<i>Think carefully... Which ones have already made it into the books...?
<i>Think carefully... Which ones have already made it into the books...?
[Kill more] Coordinated with action sequence
Her analysis of the Sillage Society, her investigations into every suspicious activity, all her records, and even her reasoning process had all been uploaded before the lockdown.
The network was cut off soon after, but those fragments should be enough to raise suspicion. Those experts will notice something and follow the clues.
<i>Which ones have already been entrusted to others?
<i>Which ones have already been entrusted to others?
[Kill one] Coordinated with action sequence
She's already explained the rise of the industrial sector to the "teacher" across the Rust, and she's passed her fieldwork records to the Chief. As for that voice recorder...
Her student should have it by now. That way, the distorted records can be set straight, and her own misdeeds will be exposed.
<i>And be careful... Some things must always remain unspoken. They must stay buried in her heart forever.
<i>Just a little longer... She isn't ready to let go... Not yet.
N.F. 33,

steps.speaker: Academic Chronicler
steps.content: The future is yours now!

steps.speaker: Military Chronicler
steps.content: Take it... Get it out... We can't let those guys win... You... must... get it... out...

steps.speaker: Commerce-Politics Chronicler
steps.content: I've had enough of this... Take it, and do whatever you want with it...
They came bearing hope, endured hardship, and trudged through despair.
Many more left in solitude.
Fortunately, some still kept their faith. Some chose to wait. And some passed the records down to her...

steps.speaker: Miner Chronicler
steps.content: I believe it all still means something. And I'm willing to believe in you, too... Go on. It's in your hands now...
She did well, didn't she? Whether driven by duty or simply by passion, she filled in so many gaps, corrected so many errors.
The truth was so fascinating. She was mesmerized by it, always delighted to share her findings.
She wanted to do the same as her predecessors. To pass it on.
In hindsight, perhaps she'd been too absorbed in the past, always forgetting to look ahead.
[CG: Linda reaches out her hand]

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Professor! Professor! Professor, I have another question... What is the truth? Can I see it too?

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: I'm sorry, Professor...

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: I don't know... if history still has any value in today's DisCity...

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: I'm afraid I can't pass it on for you...
If only I hadn't been so consumed by the past. If only I'd spent more time embracing the future...

steps.speaker: Nameless Chronicler
steps.content: What are you apologizing for? Silly girl. Only those with true passion face this kind of frustration. I should thank you... for devoting your best years to this lonely path.

steps.speaker: Nameless Chronicler
steps.content: I'm afraid I'll soon become a burden to you, keeping you from leaving for quite a while.

steps.speaker: Nameless Chronicler
steps.content: So why not stick around on this path for just a little longer? You might discover a different kind of joy, as I did.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: You want to talk about Rustfire? Ah, you really know your stuff! I've composed 108 new epic poems celebrating this radiant era! Not just my own hand, mind you, but collaborative works with the future blossoms of West District! You must include them all in your history book!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ooh, ooh, me too! I know stuff about outside the city, way, way farther than WhiteSands! I just got back, in fact! Oh, and I can tell you all about my adventures too!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: The road they once walked alone has become a glorious legacy. Now it's been passed down into my hands. I love it. I've always loved it. I... I want to be like them too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like many in this city, we believe in logic and reason—the fruits of our civilization. We also believe in those who have reached the pinnacle of rationality, who dedicate themselves to the pursuit of truth and knowledge.

steps.speaker: Nameless Chronicler
steps.content: Like a gold panner by the riverbank, not seeking to turn the current, but to step into time itself, stand firm in the mud, and pick out a few precious grains from the dirt.

steps.speaker: Nameless Chronicler
steps.content: Then wash and polish them, string them together, and offer them to those deserving of the gift. Plant a dream in a budding scientist. Point the way for those standing at the crossroads of change.

steps.speaker: Nameless Chronicler
steps.content: We may not change the river's course, but who knows where those who walk beside us will one day end up? Who says they can't make new waves?

steps.speaker: Nameless Chronicler
steps.content: So, let's look forward to it. After all, we're all part of the same great river, moving ever onward.
[Back to the burning library]
At last, she sees the black bipyramid hovering in the shadows. Motionless, it is watching in silence.
Of course. The assassins are here. To lull them into lowering their guard, we must make them believe they've successfully silenced their target. Just as they once deceived us.
[Transition to flashback in place, normal library] [No black-and-white transition, direct fade in/fade out 17]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is a special power. Please preserve truths that cannot exist in official history, and seek out the records that were purposely erased. Pass them to those you trust.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: When you can no longer protect it, I will come to retrieve it. I will collect your memories by reading your Mania.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: And then, when your successor appears, I will pass it on once more.
[Burning library background] [Same, no black-and-white transition]
So it came... Could have at least said hello. It would have spared her the long wait.
She's done enough. At last, what she's been waiting for is here.
All history needs is a witness.
[Celine's Final Battle]
Her memories are ablaze, as pages dance wildly amid the flames.
The nameless chronicler unleashes all her power on the battlefield that will be remembered by no one.

steps.speaker: Nameless Chronicler
steps.content: Does history still have any value in today's DisCity? The enemy has already answered that question for me. As for what power the truth really holds, tonight will be the proof.

steps.speaker: Nameless Chronicler
steps.content: Let this towering blaze crown the silent pages.
[Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Nameless Chronicler
steps.content: As for me...
All the lies she's told, all the facts she's twisted... Someone will recognize her hidden motives, take apart her point of view, and expose the chronicler's little scheme...
Let them see through her. Then, through her eyes, let them witness the truth she's preserved.
And then... let them carry her will forward.
